---
title: Settle the canonical domain and fix inconsistent links
labels: needs-info, maintenance
---

**Context.** The agreed main link is https://www.aquilacyber.org/. This repository uses only that domain. Elsewhere the picture is mixed:
- The page metadata on aquilacyber.org uses aquilacyber.com in its `og:url` and `og:image` values.
- The `Aquilacyber-CTF` README lists alturacyber.com/aquilacyber and a `.com` support address.

**Needed.**
1. Confirm the canonical domain.
2. Check that the other domains redirect to it.
3. Fix the site metadata and the portal README.
4. Check that the support email address on the `.com` domain is monitored.

**Done when.** One domain is used everywhere and the others redirect.
